text:
maya: Heads up — console telemetry sampling change pushed to prod this morning is causing our SDKs to see 'x-sample-rate' drop to 0 unexpectedly when quota backpressure kicks in. Noticed customer dashboards show 0% for some tenants.
jonathan: Oof. Is that the new adaptive-sampling plumbing you landed?
maya: yeah, it's the adaptive sampler that switches to aggressive downsample under heavy batch throttling. The problem is SDKs treat absence of header as 0 rather than fallback to last-known/default.
sophia: Can you paste the header example?
maya: sure — current prod header looks like: ```x-sample-rate: 0``` when throttled, and absent when we short-circuit. SDKs should interpret absent => use client default, not 0.
liam: This explains alerts we saw from enterprise customers: their per-route sparkline dropped to flatline.
jonathan: Quick mitigation idea: opt-in feature flag to make sampler emit `x-sample-mode: aggressive|steady` instead of zeroing numeric rate. Then SDKs can map modes to local fallback logic. Easier than changing all SDKs overnight.
sophia: I like the flag route. We should also add a console toggle to visualize mode vs numeric rate. Product asked for human-friendly reads not raw zeros.
maya: Implementation note — backend change is tiny but SDK rollout is the hard part (Py/TS/Go). Need to coordinate canary and docs.
liam: SDK owners: @sophia for Python, @jonathan for TS, I can help with Go. Can we do a staggered canary 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 48h?
sophia: Yes for Python. I'll add header fallback: prefer `x-sample-rate` if present and >0 else check `x-sample-mode` else use config.default_sample_rate. Patch snippet for py client: ```python
# sdk telemetry header parsing
def parse_sample(headers, config):
    if 'x-sample-rate' in headers:
        try:
            r = float(headers['x-sample-rate'])
            if r > 0: return r
        except: pass
    mode = headers.get('x-sample-mode')
    return config.mode_map.get(mode, config.default_sample_rate)
```
jonathan: TS counterpart: ```ts
function parseSample(h: Record<string,string>, cfg: Config){
  const rate = Number(h['x-sample-rate']);
  if (!Number.isNaN(rate) && rate > 0) return rate;
  return cfg.modeMap[h['x-sample-mode'] as string] ?? cfg.defaultSample;
}
```
liam: Go patch looks similar, will open PR after we agree on mode enum values.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline note: change to sampler flag requires console DB migration for sampled_mode index. Scheduled maintenance window: 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC.
maya: Hmm we should avoid maintenance if possible — customers on Dedicated might not want a DB migration. Can we keep backward compat by making `x-sample-mode` optional and mapping unknowns to `steady`?
jonathan: Yes, plan: backend adds optional header, no DB migration now. If we later add dashboard heatmaps for mode, we can do a migration.
sophia: Docs: I'll add a short breaking-change note: "SDKs will now honor `x-sample-mode` when `x-sample-rate` absent or zero; ensure you upgrade to SDK >= v2.4.1 to avoid 0% dashboard artifacts."
liam: Can we avoid marking it as "breaking"? It's more of an improvement but technically behavior changes. Product prefers "behavioral change with migration guidance".
maya: Also need a console UX card for rollout: show canary % and list of tenants in canary. Devex wants this before we flip to 30%.
jonathan: I'll wire a small endpoint that returns current canary set so Console can render it. Endpoint will be behind admin auth only.
sophia: Timeline proposal: today — merge SDK parsing PRs as opt-in behind env var; tomorrow morning — enable header emission for 10% canary tenants; 24h observe; then 48h increase.
liam: I'll own the Go PR and coordinate with infra to toggle canary.
maya: Add telemetry / eval: define promptset to ensure sampling changes don't skew evaluation metrics. We should run a quick A/B for quality metrics for 10% vs control.
jonathan: agreed. I'll add a small dashboard tile comparing request-per-second and sample_rate distributions.
sophia: Ok I'm going to open the Python PR now and include the snippet above, plus a changelog entry and migration note.
maya: Thanks team. Let's sync in #release-war-room when canary flips. :rocket:
ops-bot: Reminder: created issue #TI-4267 "sampling-mode header rollout" and assigned to maya, sophia, jonathan, liam.
